correctness.rationale: The shell-normalized Gram operator on Fourier degree <=2 separates into orthogonal nonzero-label contrast multiplicity sectors. Radial symmetric Johnson harmonic degrees 0,1,2 yield L0,L1,L2 respectively; selecting one zero-mean nonzero-symbol contrast yields one constant plus n−2 independent difference directions for L3,L4, and two-contrast factors yield L5. Conditional support occupancies a_j=(k)_j/(n)_j produce the six asserted rational eigenvalues. Their positive multiplicities sum binom(n,2)(q−1)², with nullity 1+n(q−1). The activity equation R=sum I_i-k times H<=1 is injective in H<=1 for 2<=k<=n−2 and vanishes on the shell, so dimension counting makes it the entire nullspace. Unnormalized compressed K eigenvalues are shell probability w times shell-normalized L. Independently recomputed exact integer shell-projection Gram traces and Frobenius square moments, predicted ranks and six-branch values for (q,n,k)=(3,4,2),(3,5,2),(3,5,3),(4,4,2), including zero multiplicities. These examples support but are not an exhaustive proof for arbitrary q,n,k; the analytic conditional block argument is required.
